mettle.perk.backstab.description: Sneak attacks on unaware foes deal double damage.
mettle.perk.coin_sense.description: Better prices in towns, and your coins weigh half.
mettle.perk.field_dressing.description: Animals you hunt drop extra meat and hide.
mettle.perk.green_thumb.description: Crops you plant sometimes sprout a stage early.
mettle.perk.mining.deep_delver.descripti: Below y 0 you take 30%% less damage, mine 25%% faster and never get hurt by falling rock.
mettle.perk.mining.diamond_hands.descrip: Diamond ore drops one extra 25%% of the time.
mettle.perk.mining.down_there.descriptio: You see a little further in the dark underground.
mettle.perk.mining.down_there.hint: Spend long enough in the deep and it spends time in you.
mettle.perk.mining.forgemaster.descripti: Raw iron, gold and copper you mine have a 15%% chance to drop as an ingot.

mettle.perk.mining.motherlode.descriptio: Sneak-mine an ore to break its whole vein, up to 24 blocks.
mettle.perk.mining.mountain_breaker.desc: Sneak-mining stone breaks a 3×3 face at once.
mettle.perk.mining.ore_sense.description: Sneaking with a pickaxe, ore near the block you look at gives a soft chime.
mettle.perk.mining.prospector.descriptio: Ores have a %s%% chance to drop one extra.
mettle.perk.mining.rock_hauler.descripti: Stone, ore, raw metal and ingots weigh 40%% less for you.
mettle.perk.mining.stonesense.descriptio: Hold sneak with a pickaxe for two seconds: a low hum leads towards the nearest diamond ore within 16 blocks.
mettle.perk.mining.stonesense.hint: Taught by a master miner, or found in The Delver’s Almanac.
mettle.perk.mining.strike_the_seam.descr: The first ore you break in each vein drops double.
mettle.perk.mining.sure_footing.descript: Mining while climbing, swimming or in the air is only half as slow.
mettle.perk.mining.tunneler.description: Sneak-mining with a pickaxe breaks a 1×2 passage.
mettle.perk.smiths_eye.description: See exact durability; anvils never say Too Expensive.
mettle.perk.well_read.description: Double XP from books; enchanting costs one level less.
